newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wong's Kong rights issue oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Wong's Kong rights issue oversubscribed.

text.p: Wong's Kong King International (Holdings) Ltd said on Tuesday its rights issue of 199.92 million new shares was 1.18 times subscribed.
Wong's Kong King aimed to raise HK$49 million by way of a rights issue of shares on the basis of two rights shares for every five shares held at HK$0.25 per rights share.
The company, which trades chemicals and equipment used to manufacture electronic products, said the proceeds would be used to repay bank borrowings and for working capital.
